{{Top|leg}}
The '''doyen''' was the leader of the [[Assassin's Guild/Legends|Assassin's Guild]] and considered the greatest of all [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. Eventually, a better assassin would kill the doyen and take over the position. [[Gender/Legends|Female]] doyens were called doyennes.<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
